title: Data dictionary: Form 990 and 990-EZ
text: Variables fields. variable field one form. pools every xpath records thing: 990 990-EZ versions line (example total revenue), element names different schema years (IRS renamed elements 2013). variable exists full 990 (number volunteers, say) missing 990-EZ filers. Names follow FF_PP_NAME: FF form: F9 Form 990 990-EZ (return header), SA SR Schedules R. PP part form (00 heading, 01 Part , …; 99 lines earlier versions schedule). NAME describes field; _X marks checkbox, _CY/_PY current prior year, _BOY/_EOY beginning end year. Scope says returns report variable: header (returns, including 990-PF), 990 (full form ), 990-EZ (EZ ) 990 + 990-EZ. 990-EZ lines mapped matching part 990. Tables. variable column one table. ONE tables one row per filing; MANY tables one row per repeated item (person, grant recipient, facility). Part III program tables share variable names purpose, programs can stacked. Type numeric, text, checkbox date; identifiers EINs ZIP codes text. list marks field whose repeated values joined one cell (example states return filed). Location form, part line code variable. table block headed name cardinality: ONE (one row per filing) MANY (one row per repeated item). % Reporting percent filers variable’s scope whose return reports newest schema year (TY2024). 990 + 990-EZ variable shows two values, 990/990-EZ (example 16.9%/3.2%). <0.1% one filer thousand; blank means variable current schema.
